ORDINANCE

BE IT ORDAINED BY THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF CHICAGO:

SECTION 1. The Chicago Zoning Ordinance is amended by changing all of the PD 836,
Planned Development District symbols and indications as shown on Map No. 1-J in the
area bound by:

North Spaulding Avenue; a line 75 feet north of and parallel to the alley next north of
West Franklin Boulevard; North Sawyer Avenue; the alley next north of and parallel to
West Franklin Boulevard; North Kedzie Avenue; and West Franklin Boulevard,

to those of a B3-1, Community Shopping District.

SECTION 2. This ordinance shall be effective after its passage and publication.

Patrick Murphey
Zoning Administrator

Common Address:

3250-3256 W. Franklin Boulevard
519-523 N. Spaulding Avenue
520-522 N. Sawyer Avenue
